candidate.name: MCL Crowded-Transport One-Hour Capture
candidate.change: give only causally elevated micro-participation admissions a maximum one-hour executable-bar lifetime
candidate.hypothesis: when MCL barrel-equivalent participation is simultaneously elevated versus its causal one-hour and six-hour baselines, the executable micro book is crowded: direction remains valid briefly, but persistence decays before v18's next raw-turn exit

frozen_signal_direction_and_risk.engine_and_router: v18 exact CL discovery, MCL confirmation, basis-velocity route, and lead-breadth profile
frozen_signal_direction_and_risk.failed_auction_profit_memory: v18 exact 0.5 percent activation and 25 percent running-MFE retention; it may exit before the capture clock
frozen_signal_direction_and_risk.roll_and_costs: v18 exact dual-volume roll, flat-until-fresh-turn law, and 3.52/5.52 USD round-trip costs
frozen_signal_direction_and_risk.admission_and_direction: unchanged; crowded transport cannot veto, invert, add, or size a trade

crowded_transport_state.volume_share: 100 times MCL contracts divided by 1000 times CL contracts plus 100 times MCL contracts on the completed raw-turn five-minute bar
crowded_transport_state.fast_baseline: median of the previous 12 completed contiguous five-minute shares, excluding the current bar
crowded_transport_state.slow_baseline: median of the previous 72 completed contiguous five-minute shares, excluding the current bar
crowded_transport_state.active: current share is strictly above both baselines
crowded_transport_state.insufficient_history: not crowded; v18 lifecycle remains unchanged
crowded_transport_state.reset: clear both baselines on contract roll or tape discontinuity

declared_lifecycles.primary_60: close a still-open crowded position at the open after 60 completed executable one-minute bars; existing profit-memory, raw-turn, and roll exits retain precedence
declared_lifecycles.neighbour_30: same law after 30 completed executable one-minute bars
declared_lifecycles.neighbour_120: same law after 120 completed executable one-minute bars

selection_law: the one-hour primary is chosen from the causal fast participation horizon before capture outcomes; 30/120-minute cells are semantic sensitivity neighbors and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes
prohibitions: no volume-share, median, lookback, hold, profit-memory, basis, breadth, or parity threshold sweep
no abstention, direction inversion, daily quota, synthetic re-entry, target, or stop
no curve, calendar, session, ATR, or news interaction
no crown or live authority from exposed history
